description: This file is a shell script used for device-initiated firmware downloads and related upgrade procedures. It handles downloading firmware via HTTP/TFTP, manages upgrade status, processes responses from a cloud server, and triggers flashing routines based on upgrade conditions.

methods.name: updateFWDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates the firmware download status in a log file, capturing various status parameters.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from version.txt.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines the build type (vbn, prod, qa, dev) based on firmware version tags.

methods.name: sendTLSRequest
methods.description: Performs a curl command to send a TLS request to the cloud URL, checking HTTP response code.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Performs a TFTP download of a firmware image.

methods.name: imageDownloadToLocalServer
methods.description: Triggers the download of the firmware image to the local server via specified protocol.

methods.name: invokeImageFlasher
methods.description: Starts the image flashing process by invoking an external script.

methods.name: getServURL
methods.description: Determines the server URL based on build type and configuration.

methods.name: triggerPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Initiates a PCI firmware upgrade sequence.

methods.name: checkForValidPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if a PCI upgrade is needed based on version differences.

methods.name: checkForUpgrades
methods.description: Main logic for verifying if firmware upgrades are required and triggering upgrades.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses the JSON response from the cloud to extract firmware details.

methods.name: exitForXconf404response
methods.description: Handles case when HTTP 404 is received from Xconf server, logging and exiting.

methods.name: createJsonString
methods.description: Creates a JSON string with device and capability info for cloud communication.

methods.name: sendXCONFTLSRequest
methods.description: Retries sending a TLS request to Xconf server with retries.

methods.name: sendXCONFRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to Xconf server.

methods.name: sendJsonRequestToCloud
methods.description: Sends JSON request to cloud to fetch firmware update info.
